fields.description: 32-bit little-endian sum of the 64 payload halfwords that follow (custom algorithm, see SPEC.md).
fields.evidence: FUN_08019ee4 accumulates local_38[0] as the sum of 64 LE halfwords over the 128-byte payload (data words) and stores it with FUN_080224e4/FUN_080224f8 at EEPROM word param_1. Verified: LE u32 at logical offset 0 is 0x359d60, exactly the halfword sum of logical bytes [8,136).
fields.name: checksum_value

fields.description: Upper 32 bits of the 8-byte checksum word; always zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_08019ee4 zeroes local_38[1] alongside the checksum (initialization before the sum loop) and writes both words via FUN_080224e4; 0x00000000 in baseline primary and backup copies.
fields.name: checksum_pad

fields.description: 4-byte header tag at the start of the save payload.
fields.evidence: First payload word written by FUN_08019ee4's data loop (EEPROM words param_1+1 onward). Bytes 0x50 0x52 0x43 0x52 ('PRCR') verified at logical offsets 8 and 0x90 in samples/baseline.sav.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Structural zero byte ahead of the status byte; writer not in recovered decomp.
fields.evidence: Inside FUN_08019ee4's 16-word data region (payload byte 4); observed 0x00 in baseline primary and backup copies.
fields.name: status_byte_a

fields.description: Mutable payload status byte; bit 1 is cleared by the save task immediately before the EEPROM write.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008fc0 executes *(byte *)(save_buffer + 5) &= 0xfd (file offset 13) and then calls FUN_08019ee4(0,0x80,...) / FUN_08019ee4(0x11,0x80,...). Live value 0xfa in baseline (both copies).
fields.name: save_status_flags

fields.description: Structural zero halfword after the status byte; writer not in recovered decomp.
fields.evidence: Inside FUN_08019ee4's 16-word data region (payload bytes 6-7); observed 0x0000 in baseline primary and backup copies.
fields.name: status_byte_b

fields.description: Unused zero block (payload data words 2-3); writer not in recovered decomp.
fields.evidence: Inside FUN_08019ee4's 16-word data region (payload bytes 8-23); all 0x00 in baseline primary and backup copies.
fields.name: reserved_zero_block

fields.description: Boundary byte between the written header area and the erased fill; exact role unknown.
fields.evidence: Payload byte 24 at the edge of FUN_08019ee4's data region; observed 0x00 followed by 0xff fill in baseline primary and backup copies. Writer not in recovered decomp.
fields.name: data_end_marker

fields.description: Unwritten region; reads back erased EEPROM state.
fields.evidence: FUN_08019ee4 with param_2=0x80 writes only 17 EEPROM words (8-byte checksum word + 16 data words) per copy, so payload bytes 25-127 are never written; 0xff throughout logical offsets 33-135 and 0xAB-0x10F in baseline.
fields.name: erased_fill

fields.description: Backup copy of the checksum; same logical data as checksum_value.
fields.evidence: FUN_08008fc0 writes the identical RAM buffer a second time via FUN_08019ee4(0x11,0x80,...), i.e. EEPROM word 0x11 (byte 0x88); LE u32 at logical offset 0x88 is 0x359d60, matching the primary and the halfword sum of logical bytes [0x90,0x110).
fields.name: checksum_value_backup

fields.description: Backup copy of the header tag; same logical data as save_magic.
fields.evidence: Written by the second FUN_08019ee4(0x11,0x80,...) call in FUN_08008fc0; bytes 0x50 0x52 0x43 0x52 ('PRCR') verified at logical offset 0x90 in baseline.
fields.name: save_magic_backup

fields.description: Backup copy of the payload status byte; same logical data as save_status_flags.
fields.evidence: Written by the second FUN_08019ee4(0x11,0x80,...) call in FUN_08008fc0; observed 0xfa at logical offset 0x95 in baseline, identical to the primary.
fields.name: save_status_flags_backup
